series: trendwatching.com annual consumer trends (free Trend Briefing)
title: 5 Trends for 2016
notes: First archived 2015-11-14. Each trend is filed under a 'Parent mega-trend' (recorded as section). The full 2016 Trend Report ('Released November 17', Premium only) is not captured. target_year 2016 from the title.

entries.label: STATUS TESTS
entries.quote: In 2016, consumers will embrace a new twist on a traditional form of cachet: exclusivity.
entries.subject: Brands making customers prove their worth for exclusive access

entries.label: CONTEXTUAL OMNIPRESENCE
entries.quote: smart brands will focus on answering a more meaningful equation: innovative channels + nuanced contexts = right place + right time.
entries.subject: Context-aware service channels
entries.note: Dek: 'Forget omnichannel. Get ready for new channels and new contexts.' Parent mega-trend is printed 'Helpfull'.

entries.label: INSIDER TRADING
entries.quote: One suggestion for 2016: turn inwards, and start by ensuring your internal culture is something to flaunt, rather than hide.
entries.subject: Employee treatment as a brand asset
entries.note: Label printed 'Insider trading' in the nav and INSIDER TRADING in the body.

entries.label: BENEFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
entries.quote: In 2016, rising numbers of consumers will demand that brands use increasingly powerful and accessible artificial intelligence technologies to put truly smart products and services into their pockets, homes, inboxes, and more.
entries.subject: Consumer-facing artificial intelligence

entries.label: PERSPECTIVE SHIFTS
entries.quote: Playfully reposition your product or service in order to offer PERSPECTIVE SHIFTS that shock customers into a radically new appreciation of the value you're offering .
entries.subject: Repositioning perceived value and price
entries.note: Parent mega-trend PRICING PANDEMONIUM was itself a 2011 trend.
